title: Mtek context export
description: The document `mtek context` prints (spec/ai-and-benchmarks.md section 2, decisions 0072 and 0110). contextFormat 2 (decision 0110: field lines instead of field objects, schemaGuide, reference). Keys are never added without a new contextFormat, so unknown keys are errors.

languageVersion.description: The language version this compiler build implements.

compilerVersion.description: The version of the compiler build that produced the document.

features.description: What this build implements: language constructs by name, then library items as kind:name. Derived from the build, never written by hand. A cold-start context (one with reference.builtins) leaves out the function:* entries, whose signatures reference.builtins gives (decision 0148).

notSupported.description: What this build rejects: planned features as 'name (planned for Mn)', reserved words, and what v0.1 never accepts.

entry.description: The entry module, relative to the project root.

scene.description: The entry scene; null if the project selects none.

modules.description: Every module of the project in load order, relative to the project root.

symbols.description: The requested declarations (or the entry scene's), what is nested in them, and the declarations one reference away; in module load order and source order.

schemaGuide.description: How to read the field lines of schemas.

schemas.description: The registry schemas the requested declarations use, sorted by name, with the fields this build implements. For a cold-start project (no entity, prefab, material, function, constant or struct) every implemented schema that has fields, with the documentation and range of its fields.

reference.description: Present only for a cold-start project: the built-in library, generated from the registry. Each key is a section that --max-bytes can drop whole (lowest priority first: records, body, events, builtins with typeClasses, conventions, enums).

typeClasses.description: What the type classes T, I and V stand for in builtins.

builtins.description: Signatures of the built-in functions, namespace members and accessors; the registry's documentation follows ' // ' where a signature does not say enough.

events.description: The events a handler can subscribe to.

records.description: Built-in record types and their fields.

body.description: Body commands and readable body properties.

conventions.description: Cross-cutting rules (colour spaces, time), quoted from the registry's documentation.

examples.description: Complete programs that mtek check accepts, most relevant first.

truncated.description: Present only when --max-bytes made the export leave something out: per section how many items were dropped and the names of the first few, lowest priority first.

count.description: How many items were left out.

names.description: The names of the first (at most 16) items left out, lowest priority first.

name.description: The declaration names from the module item down, joined by '.'.

kind.description: scene, entity, prefab, material, compute, input, output, kernel, struct, fn, cpu_fn, const, state, param, or the keyword of a scene object (camera).

type.description: The type as written, or a short description for a declaration without one.

doc.description: The documentation comment, '///' lines joined by a line feed; empty if none.
The registry documentation of the schema; only for a cold-start project.

field.description: One field: `name: type`, then ` = default` (canonical source text) when it has one, ` [flags]` when it has any (some of R required, W writable from handlers, B bindable, C construction-only, in that order), and for a cold-start project ` range R` when the range says more than 'greater than zero' and ` // meaning` (the registry documentation).

members.description: Every member this build implements, as written after the enum's name and a point, separated by one space.

notes.description: `item: documentation`, one per registry item the convention concerns.
